title: Forecast Calibration Curve
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:outcome
| eval bucket=round(confidence,-1)
| stats avg(eval(if(result="correct",1,0))) as hit_rate, count as n by bucket
| eval hit_pct=round(100*hit_rate,1)
| sort bucket
description: Compares how often your predictions come true against how confident you were, building a personal calibration curve.
value: Good calibration — being right about as often as you claim — is a learnable skill and the core of good judgement.
implementation: Ingest forecasts and resolved outcomes into `index=personal`; group hit rate by confidence bucket.
visualization: Scatter or line chart of confidence versus actual hit rate.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether things you were sure about actually happened, showing how well you really judge the future.
